verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a SaaS speech-to-text API, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its docs homepage has a single 'Connect to Cursor / Install MCP server on Cursor' entry point, which points to a first-party MCP server. Nothing in the evidence says what it exposes: it may be only a documentation-search server rather than one giving agents access to transcription jobs. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's tools and scope, evidence it exposes transcription/streaming API capabilities to agents, setup instructions beyond Cursor, independent or hands-on corroboration.
